headline: When to Call a Professional for Hidden Wall Moisture and Water Damage
articleBody:
Minor spills on tile are easy to wipe dry, but structural water intrusion behind walls and beneath flooring is a different story. Recognizing warning signs early prevents extensive secondary structural damage.

Look out for these clear warning signals around your home:
- Soft, spongy drywall or bubbling paint along baseboards and interior walls.
- Persistent musty odors in closed rooms, even after running air conditioning.
- Warped, cupping hardwood planks or loose, lifting vinyl flooring seams.
- Visible staining spreading upward from baseboards or across ceilings below bathrooms.
- Moisture readings that remain high inside wall cavities after 48 hours of basic fan use.

When Professional Guidance Helps
Water spreads quickly along subfloors and into hidden wall cavities. While surface moisture dries under household fans, trapped water inside insulation, wall framing, and subfloors creates prime conditions for mold growth. EPA guidelines emphasize that materials wet for more than 48 hours require careful inspection and often material removal. 

A licensed remodeling contractor tests framing moisture, safely cuts back compromised drywall, replaces wet insulation, and restores your walls to pristine condition.
